title: Emergency Response: Clear a Power Bus Fault

steps.hint: The POWER panel is straight ahead at chest height. It shows each power bus, a line that feeds power to a group of systems.
Press ACK under the flashing CAUTION light on the POWER panel. Acknowledging confirms you have seen the alarm; it does not fix the fault.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the display above the POWER panel. The checklist lists every step of the procedure, so nothing is missed.
Read the caption under the CAUTION light: it names the bus. Select that bus display, the one whose FAULT light is lit.
Turn the BUS B dial below the bus display until it points at ISOLATE. Isolating disconnects the faulted bus so the fault cannot spread.
Pull the CROSS-TIE lever on the right of the POWER panel down to CLOSED. The cross-tie lets healthy Bus A feed Bus B systems.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT when the STATUS display shows RESTORED.
steps.hint: First check that the STATUS display reads RESTORED. REPORT is the button below it; pressing it tells mission control the fault is cleared.
